name: Rekka Guava-Szechuan Blaze
description: A bold, polarizing soda that pairs synth-guava sweetness with the numbing tingle of Szechuan pepper extract. Rekka Industries markets it as a 'sensory experience,' and the BCI-paired version delivers a mild warmth pulse to the tongue region.
flavor_profile: Sweet tropical guava with an immediate Szechuan numbness that spreads across the palate. Fruity but electrically spiced, with a long tingly finish.
slogan: Feel it before you taste it.
cultural_context: Rekka Guava-Szechuan Blaze is a social drink — people dare each other to finish cans quickly because the Szechuan effect intensifies with carbonation speed. BCI users report the paired signal makes the tingle feel like a mild static charge across the jaw, which has become a party trick in Tier 2-3 social settings.
story_hooks: The BCI-paired sensory signal in Rekka Blaze has an undocumented secondary effect that only manifests in users with a specific augmentation chipset — and someone is deliberately triggering it.
A Tier 3 underground fight circuit uses Rekka Blaze as its unofficial sponsor — fighters drink it before bouts and claim the Szechuan signal sharpens reflexes.
Rekka Industries is accused of illegally amplifying the BCI signal in a bad batch, causing neurological discomfort in several hundred consumers — and is suppressing the incident reports.
